title: Root bar · round 1 · ruled
intro: Claude Design, 21 Nov. Companion root bar with native items only (hosted custom views cost ~48 ms per back move and draw only when a swipe ends). iPhone 18 Pro dark + light, iPad.

Ruling: capsule = Text-only stock Menu; Mac offline in the system subtitle; Inbox = tray / tray.full.fill, no badge, own glass; top trailing = [Inbox] · [New]. Voice leaves the top bar: a voice bar in tabViewBottomAccessory on tab roots (hold to talk, tap for hands-free), the same view in a bottom safe-area inset on composer-less pushed pages (the floating mic retires). Fallback: native top-bar mic, tap only. Gate: root bar ≤ 10 ms per push and pop, items move with the bar mid-swipe.
Q3 Mic and Q4 Order still show the mic in the top bar (the B3 fallback); Q3b and the ruling board override them.
